en: GOOGLE RE-READ THE SITEMAP AFTER EIGHT DAYS. Search Console now shows last read 29 Sep (was 21 Sep) and discovered pages moved 116 → 119, matching the live sitemap exactly for the first time in this series. The three pages Google had not seen are now discovered; indexing them is a separate step that has not happened yet.

GSC WAS MIXED ON A CLEAN ONE-DAY STEP: impressions rose 1,051 → 1,056 and average position improved again 26.0 → 25.8, a fifth consecutive gain, while clicks fell 32 → 30 and CTR 3.0% → 2.8%. The click fall is arithmetic, not decay: 30 Aug left the window carrying 4 clicks and 27 Sep entered carrying 2.

BRAND SHARE FELL 75.0% → 70.0% — but for the wrong reason. 21 of 30 clicks still come from four navigational brand queries; the share only moved because one odd non-brand query, "i want 3 months" (1 click at position 2.0), entered the table. No commercial non-brand query gained a click.

THE TRACKED RANKING BOARD IS FROZEN AGAIN: ten of the eleven tracked queries are unchanged on BOTH position and impressions for a second day running. The only movement is custom living space melbourne, whose impressions edged 21 → 20 with position held at 36.1.

THE ADELAIDE CLUSTER THINNED FROM FOUR QUERIES TO THREE: 3d visualisation adelaide 16.0 (1 impression), 3d architectural visualisation adelaide 43.5 (2) and apartment design adelaide 72.0 (2). Seven Adelaide articles produce five impressions between them and nothing on page one.
EVERY COMMERCIAL NON-BRAND QUERY REMAINS AT ZERO CLICKS — 54 consecutive days. 19 queries sit on page one, seventeen of them navigational "dx" variants.

GA4 SESSIONS ROSE 555 → 559 AND A FOURTH KEY EVENT APPEARED — the first ever produced by Organic Search, where all three previous key events came from Direct. Engagement rate eased 34.59% → 33.99% because sessions rose while engaged sessions fell 192 → 190.

A SECOND AI PLATFORM SENT REAL TRAFFIC FOR THE FIRST TIME. The AI Assistant channel rose 7 → 8 sessions and is no longer chatgpt.com alone: copilot.com / ai-assistant contributed one session. It is a single session and may not repeat, but it is the first non-ChatGPT AI referral this property has recorded.

THE ENGAGEMENT RECOVERY HELD FOR A THIRD WEEK. In the last 7 days engagement rate rose 25.86% → 31.58% and average engagement time went from 9 seconds to 1m 04s, on fewer sessions (174 → 152) but more events (676 → 776). Fewer, far better visits is the clearest positive trend in this report.

ORGANIC SEARCH IS STILL THE BEST-QUALITY CHANNEL BY A WIDE MARGIN: 129 sessions at 60.47% engagement and 1m 43s, against Organic Social's 155 sessions at 25.16% and 3 seconds. Facebook's five source/medium variants now carry 147 sessions, more than google / organic at 112.

AHREFS SPAM INFLUX CONTINUED AT THE SAME HIGH RATE: referring domains 814 → 882 and backlinks 850 → 918, both up 68. CRITICALLY, THE FOLLOWED COUNTS DID NOT MOVE AT ALL (301 domains, 307 links, identical to yesterday) — every single new link is nofollow, so the followed share fell 37.0% → 34.1% purely by dilution. DR and UR remain 0 and Ahrefs Rank worsened to 195.8M.

AI CITATIONS FELL 17 → 16 AND CITED PAGES 11 → 10, entirely on ChatGPT (7 → 6 responses, 6 → 5 pages) while Copilot held at 10 responses and 7 pages. Grok remains paused by Ahrefs and is recorded as null, not zero.

THE AI VISIBILITY SCORE HOLDS AT 28. Cited pages fell but 10 of 95 articles is 10.5%, which still rounds to 1/10 on citation surface, so no dimension changed. The score stays capped by third-party corpus at 0 and measurement at 1 — Brand Radar still tracks 0 prompts, so share of voice, accuracy and sentiment cannot be measured at all.

AHREFS CRAWLED PAGES: 404s FELL AGAIN 13 → 11 and 200s rose 170 → 172 across 187 crawled pages — three consecutive scans of falling 404s. The breakdown was counted row by row from the table DOM because the HTTP-code filter would not apply; ONE ROW OF 187 could not be parsed and is not counted or guessed at, so the breakdown sums to 186.

PAGE INDEXING IS STILL STALE AT 21 SEP — a ninth consecutive day without a rebuild, and byte-identical across all eight reasons (83 indexed, 148 not). Google re-read the sitemap on 29 Sep but the indexing report has not caught up with that re-read yet.

THE 118-PAGE ORIGIN CRAWL IS CLEAN: all 118 pages returned 200, all carry exactly one h1, a self-referencing canonical and a meta description (83–189 chars), and there are no heading-level skips. Every page answered in under a second — nothing in the 1–3 s band, nothing over 3 s.

SPEED DRIFTED SLIGHTLY THE WRONG WAY: the ceiling rose 581 → 650 ms and the slowest page is an article again (/articles/3d-renders-for-builders-melbourne). Site mean 323 → 342 ms and median 270 → 276 ms. This is drift inside a healthy range, not a regression.

NO NEW ARTICLE SINCE 24 SEP — a sixth consecutive day. FAQPage coverage held at 82 of 95 articles (86.3%) for a fourth scan, and 118 images still have no alt text, exactly one per page, which points at a single shared template element rather than 118 separate mistakes.

INTERNAL LINKING REMAINS A STRENGTH: zero orphans, every page with at least two inbound links, and zero articles dependent on the hub alone. The /articles overlay was re-checked today and is still gone — confirmed resolved, not merely absent once.
